title: Recent advances in metal-free catalysts for the synthesis of N-heterocyclic frameworks focusing on 5- and 6-membered rings: a review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9676-9755
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00962F, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hai Truong Nguyen, The Thai Nguyen, Vinh Thanh Chau Doan, Trinh Hao Nguyen, Minh Hai Tran
The tremendous potential of transition metal-free multi-component reactions (MCR) in the synthesis of N-heterocyclic frameworks is examined in this review, offering a complete overview of this subject matter.
